project.title: Proteomic analyses of coffea arabica subjected to various conditions
project.projectDescription: Next-generation proteomics of Coffea arabica to decipher the molecular players involved in stress adaptation.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: Protein samples were loaded on a SDS-PAGE gel for a short electrophoretic migration, excised from a single polyacrylamide band, digested by trypsin, and the resulting peptides were analyzed by  Q-Exactive HF tandem mass spectrometry.
project.dataProcessingProtocol: MS/MS spectra were analyzed by MASCOT, the results were then parsed with IRMA, spectral counts were then compared.
